items.title: Colston Loveland: Expected to land on IR
items.text:
The knee injury that Loveland sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions is expected to land him on IR, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Will remain out for Week 12
